mapper.select: select distinct p.permission_code from sys_permission p join sys_role_permission rp on rp.permission_id = p.id join sys_user_role ur on ur.role_id = rp.role_id join sys_role r on r.id = ur.role_id where ur.user_id = #{userId} and p.status = 1 and r.status = 1 and p.permission_code is not null
